rationale: David brings deep production robotics expertise (autonomous drones at Skycatch, autonomous tractors at Agtonomy) and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit — exactly the kind of complex, multi-step autonomous workflows that could benefit from Georgi's AI workflow automation platform for RevOps and sales teams. Georgi's conviction that workflow automation for GTM/RevOps is severely underserved, combined with his hands-on product and community-building background, could offer fresh perspective on how LiveKit's robotics customers operationalize their deployments.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Georgi — David's shipping production robotics at LiveKit and spent years scaling autonomous systems from prototype to production; Georgi's building no-code AI workflow automation for RevOps and sales teams and is actively hiring for GTM. Could be a valuable pairing on automation infrastructure for robotics deployments.
